M-VT0022_Lipstick___3_Light_Relight_Pipe.summary: INGESTION The existing low-res, flat-lit or off-brand asset — still, footage, or both.
M-VT0022_Lipstick___3_Light_Relight_Pipe.pipeline: reference-image-input → video-input → 4× text-gen → 3× image-gen → 3× upscaler → video-edit → 3× text-gen → image-gen → download
notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Source Forensics assesses resolution, lighting flatness, style gap vs brand target → Enhancement Director configures a 3-Light Relight pass, which changes the lighting direction, color temperature, and mood of an existing shot post-capture, as if re-lit in studio with a 3-point rig → Nano Banana Pro applies the enhancement to keyframes → Omni Flash 1.1 video-to-video re-renders the full clip carrying the enhancement through every frame with temporal consistency → Fidelity Critic (has identity/branding survived the enhancement, or has it drifted into a different product?) → Repair on drift → Package at delivery resolution (1080p/4K).
STAGE 1 — INGESTION The existing low-res, flat-lit or off-brand asset — still, footage, or both.
STAGE 2 — SOURCE FORENSICS Assesses resolution, lighting flatness and the style gap against the brand target.
STAGE 3 — ENHANCEMENT DIRECTOR Configures the 3-Light Relight pass, which changes the lighting direction, color temperature, a pass. The rule: a better capture of the SAME subject, never a redesign.
STAGE 4 — VIDEO-TO-VIDEO RE-RENDER Omni Flash 1.1 carries the enhancement through every frame with temporal consistency.
STAGE 5 — FIDELITY CRITIC + REPAIR Has identity survived the enhancement, or has it drifted into a different product? Drift triggers a lower-strength re-pass.

M-VT0470_Sneaker_Box___Conversational_Ed.title: VT0470. Sneaker Box — Conversational Edit-Refinement Loop (#3)
M-VT0470_Sneaker_Box___Conversational_Ed.summary: BASE STATE Either an uploaded clip of the Sneaker Box or a generated base.
M-VT0470_Sneaker_Box___Conversational_Ed.pipeline: video-input → reference-image-input → prompt → video-edit → text-gen → video-edit → text-gen → video-edit → text-gen → video-edit → 3× text-gen → video-edit → download

requires.name: Base video — uploaded or previously generated

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Base Generation produces or accepts the starting video → Edit-Request Parser converts each natural-language note ('make the lighting warmer', 'swap the background to a kitchen', 'change the camera to a low angle') into a structured Interactions-API turn → Omni Flash 1.1 applies each edit conversationally, preserving everything not mentioned in that turn → Turn-by-Turn Diff Critic confirms only the requested change occurred (no unintended drift elsewhere in frame) → Repair (re-issue the turn with tighter scoping) on any unintended drift → Final-state Package once the director approves the accumulated edits.
STAGE 1 — BASE STATE Either an uploaded clip of the Sneaker Box or a generated base. Every turn below edits the accumulated state, not the original.
STAGE 2 — EDIT-REQUEST PARSER + SEQUENTIAL TURNS Each natural-language note becomes one scoped Interactions-style turn. Everything not mentioned in a turn must survive that turn untouched.
STAGE 3 — TURN-BY-TURN DIFF CRITIC Confirms only the requested change occurred in each turn — unintended drift anywhere else in frame is the failure this stage exists to catch.
